subject: Vendor activation request + PO assignment for AcmeCloud (line item clarification)

Subject: Vendor activation request — Redwood <> AcmeCloud

Hi Liam / AcmeCloud procurement team,

Thanks for choosing Redwood — excited to get you onboarded. To move forward with billing and enable invoicing we need the vendor setup documents below completed:

- Completed vendor onboarding form (attached)
- Completed W-9 or local tax equivalent
- Signed SOW referencing the services and line items we agreed on
- Billing contact and preferred invoice email

A couple of important procurement notes:
- We typically issue a PO once onboarding docs are returned and finance has validated the tax docs.
- Please confirm whether you have an internal spend cap request; AcmeCloud indicated in the deal that a spend cap of $250,000/yr would be helpful. If you confirm, we can propose a PO with a corresponding cap.
- There is one line item we want to validate: the SOW line for "Dedicated inference instances" shows a unit price that differs from the last quote. If you can highlight the correct number (or return a redlined SOW), we can align the PO.

Attached: acme_onboarding_form.pdf

Next steps: please return the completed form + W-9 and either the signed SOW or a redline by end of day Tuesday so we can issue a PO.

Thanks,
Ben Carter

Ben / Lauren / Marissa,

Appreciate the clear checklist. Attached are: W9_AcmeCloud.pdf and the signed SOW (we also included a short redline calling out the dedicated instance price).

Billing contact: invoices@acmecloud.com (accounts payable)
Primary commercial contact: Liam O'Connor 
Phone: +1 617 555 0824

Regarding the spend cap: AcmeCloud requested $250,000/year during negotiation. We can accept a PO with that cap; our billing team prefers to have the PO number on the invoice.

Line item note: the SOW we returned shows "Dedicated inference instances" at $12,000/month per instance; our commercial record shows $9,500/month — we attached a redline that explains why the higher number appears (it includes a managed-support add-on). If Redwood needs the lower unit price, we can reissue a corrected SOW.

Attached: W9_AcmeCloud.pdf, SOW_AcmeCloud_signed_redline.pdf

Thanks for the quick turnaround, Liam.

On the SOW discrepancy: to avoid billing disputes we'll need one of the following before finance issues a PO:
- A corrected SOW that matches the negotiated quote (preferred), or
- A short supplement that explicitly lists the managed-support add-on with its incremental cost so the PO can separate core infra from add-ons.

Finance note to Ben: Acme's request for a $250k cap is reasonable given expected consumption, but please confirm whether we can provision that level on first PO or prefer a conservative $150k ramp with a scheduled review. Once the SOW is explicit we can map line items to GL codes and issue a PO (PO must reference Deal ID ACME-2026-74).

Liam — can you confirm which option you prefer? If you pick corrected SOW, please send it back to both legal and procurement.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Customer Contracts Lead
Redwood Inference

Subject: PO 6789123 issued (AcmeCloud) — next steps and spend cap

Hi Liam / AcmeCloud team,

Thanks for the attachments and the redline. Finance reviewed and I've created an initial PO: PO# 6789123.

Key details:
- PO number: 6789123 (please reference on all invoices)
- Issued cap: $200,000 (Finance approved a conservative initial cap; we can increase this after a 30-day usage review and CS confirmation)
- GL mapping: Dedicated compute -> GL 5402; Managed support -> GL 5803 (we need the SOW to split these lines so invoices map correctly)

Attached: PO_6789123.pdf (stub)

1) Confirm acceptance of the $200k capped PO number on invoices.
2) Provide one of the following by end of week: corrected SOW with separate line items, or a two-line supplement that breaks out the managed-support add-on.
3) Send first invoice referencing PO# 6789123 to invoices@acmecloud.com and cc ben.carter@redwood.com.

I opened internal ticket PROC-412 to track the line-item reconciliation — link below. Once we receive the corrected SOW/supplement and first invoice we will finalize the cap increase process.
